'''Valera Gorovni''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Valera Gorovni}}

== Appearance ==
She was short, little and plump, always wearing a smile. She seemed to be bustling even while standing still.

==Strength==
Valera has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|20}}. She is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|very strong]] for an Aes Sedai. Less than a dozen Aes Sedai are known to have been stronger than her at the time of her death.

==History==
She was born in the year {{ne|748}}. Her name may indicate she is [[Kandor]]i.

She went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|765}}  at the age of seventeen. After spending eight years as [[novice]] and six as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|779}}.

Like all of [[Tamra Ospenya]]'s searchers, she held onto the law with dedication and was presumably strict and orderly.

== Activities ==
She was one of [[Tamra Ospenya's Searchers]] and murdered by the [[Black Ajah]] while trying to find the [[Dragon Reborn]]. How and where she died is unknown.
